Definition: to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative
BiblicalUsage: Kabac is washing by trampling — the fuller's work of treading cloth clean, and by extension any thorough washing. Judah's blessing pictures him washing his garments in wine; Moses has the people wash their clothes before Sinai; the law makes the unclean wash after touching a carcass; and David begs God to wash him thoroughly from his iniquity.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word shows that cleansing is God's work and it goes deep. We cannot rinse ourselves clean with a quick pass — He washes thoroughly, and the washing that matters most is the one He does in the heart.
